channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Wholesale prices jumped 6.3% annually in September, biggest gain since 2022
item.description: September producer prices were expected to increase 0.6% month-over-month and 5.5% annually, according to the consensus estimate by Dow Jones.

item.title: U.S. reportedly considers use of 'mother of all bombs' as Iran vows to fight on
item.description: The U.S. military has reportedly drawn up options for strikes on Iran that include the potential use of one of the biggest nonnuclear bombs in its arsenal.

item.title: Memory stocks are getting hammered. China and a 2029 oversupply are the big worries
item.description: SK Hynix, Samsung and Micron have been some of the hardest-hit names in the latest tech sell-off.
